_comment: WHERE THE GEOGRAPHY COMES FROM, and the only hosts this repo will take bytes from.
`sha256` and `retrievedUtc` are null until `pnpm geo:audit -- --stage=fetch --real` has run.
That is an honest unfetched state, not a placeholder: nothing reads these files yet, and
`--check` refuses to proceed while any hash is null, because a byte comparison against
`nodeMajor` records the Node major that produced the artifacts. Math.sin and Math.atan2 are
implementation-approximated, so a last-bit change between majors can flip a selection
boundary and rewrite both generated files on a pull request that touched nothing.
The full licence record, with the operative clauses quoted, is docs/geo-data-licensing.md.
OpenStreetMap and everything derived from it is absent on purpose: ODbL 4.6 would oblige us
to publish our route graph free of charge to every player.
